name: Data Analyzer: Running all checks returns every expected result section
objective: Shows the combined result has timestamp, summary statistics, checks, overall verdict, issue count and issue list. Values are not checked, only presence.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run all checks with no schema or rules
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department)
steps.expected: Result has the keys timestamp, summary_stats, checks, overall_passed, total_issues and issues

name: Data Analyzer: Running all checks with declared types passes for matching data
objective: Shows the type check is included and passes when columns match their declared types.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run all checks with a schema
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department); id int, name str, age int, salary int, department str
steps.expected: The data-types check is present and passed

name: Data Analyzer: Running all checks with range rules passes for in-range data
objective: Shows the value-range check is included and passes when values obey the rules.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department); age 20-50; department in HR, IT, Finance, Sales
steps.expected: The value-ranges check is present and passed

name: Data Analyzer: Running all checks reports every kind of failure at once
objective: Shows a too-small table, bad dates and a too-low salary limit are each reported and the overall result is a fail.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run all checks with min rows 10, a date column of non-dates, and salary limit 10000
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department) plus invalid_date column of text
steps.expected: Overall failed; total issues above zero; row count, data types and value ranges checks each failed

name: Data Analyzer: Running all checks on an empty table fails the row count
objective: Shows an empty table gives an overall fail and zero rows in the summary.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.expected: Overall failed; row-count check failed; summary rows is 0

name: Data Analyzer: The minimum rows setting is applied and reported
objective: Shows a 5-row table passes a minimum of 3 and the result states both numbers.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run all checks with min rows 3
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department)

name: Data Analyzer: The pipeline counts duplicate rows
objective: Shows repeated rows are counted in the summary.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

name: Data Analyzer: The pipeline counts missing values per column
objective: Shows blank cells are counted for each column.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Blank one salary and one name, then run all checks
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, department)

name: Data Analyzer: The pipeline reports several mixed problems in one table
objective: Shows a table with out-of-range ages and an invalid date fails the date-type and range checks. The duplicate-row assertion is trivial (zero or more), so duplicates are not proven.
precondition: Offline test harness; the full quality pipeline is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run all checks with schema and age range 0-120
steps.data: 5 rows with ages 150 and -5, text in place of one date, a repeated row
steps.expected: Overall failed; issues above zero; data types failed; value ranges failed; email missing count 0; duplicate count only checked to be zero or more
